# Studio CLI command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

Every command is one API route. `nb-studio <command> --help` and `nb-studio docs <command>` show the same on the command line, for the commands you may run; this reference lists every command, with who may run it. The guides beside this directory explain signing in, profiles, CI and agents: start with [getting started](../getting-started.md).
